card.name: Potatoes and bulbs in recipes and planting
card.fires_on: Words in or right after text about potatoes, tubers and bulbs, such as a comma after 'Yukon Gold potatoes' or 'store them' in bulb-lifting advice. It fires on the linking word or punctuation after the potato or bulb mention, not on a fixed word.

modes.label: Potato in recipes
modes.description: Punctuation or small words right after potatoes in cooking text.
modes.example: 1 pound Yukon Gold potatoes<<,>> cut into 1‑inch pieces

modes.label: Bulbs and tubers in gardening
modes.description: Small words in planting or storing instructions for bulbs and tubers.
modes.example: Lift bulbs carefully only after the foliage has died down and store<< them>> in a cool, frost-free and well

modes.label: The word potato itself
modes.description: The word potato in food lists or requests.
modes.example: Mukta asked for<< potato>> chips, and Kamrul was happy
